name: oddity-re
description: Reverse-engineering and defensive-security skills for the Oddity workspace: lab operations, Ghidra MCP usage, anti-debug recognition, crackme and long-horizon RE project methods, plus the blue-team half of the security kill chain (SOC ops, SIEM/log analysis, hardening, OT/ICS, GRC) that offensive-claude deliberately omits. Also carries two project-agnostic skills: skill-manager, which assigns a project its standing power roster, and status-page, which publishes a visual progress report for any project.
